_doc: Knowledge categories per exam level — the ONE list build_knowledge.py and check_knowledge.py read (jlpt-knowledge/SKILL.md §Categories). `stem`: the data name under knowledge/<LEVEL>/ (a file <stem>.json or a folder <stem>/ of parts). `kind`: item|guide. `label`/`desc`: keys in languages/<code>/knowledge.json. item kind only: `headword` and `reading` name the shared fields a card prints as its title (reading may be null), `facts` the further shared fields printed under it (label key field_<name>), `fields` the type of every one of them (str|list), `prose_optional` the language-file fields that may be "", `pitch` whether headword pitch lines are looked up in the dataset (an entry's own `pitch` field is always honoured). `examples`/`quiz`: [min, max] per entry. `quiz_gen` (item kind): the quiz types the BUILDER generates per entry from the data (scripts/quiz_gen.py: `reading` -> `<id>#r`, `meaning` -> `<id>#m`); `quiz` then bounds only the hand-authored items beside them. A level with an empty list has no knowledge module yet (the portal shows it as coming).
